# TorudeAbi24 — 24/7 Plumbing, Electrical & Renovation Services in Tallinn, Estonia

> TorudeAbi24 (torudeabi24.ee) is a licensed professional home services company based in Tallinn, Estonia, serving the entire Harjumaa region. Core trades: plumbing, electrical work, bathroom renovation, construction, and 24/7 emergency services. Phone: +372 56 89 79 29. Email: info@torudeabi24.ee.

## Key Facts

- **Emergency response**: 30–60 minutes across Tallinn & Harjumaa
- **Availability**: 24/7 including weekends and public holidays
- **Discount**: -30% on all services 08:00–19:00 (weekdays and weekends)
- **Payment**: After completion — no upfront payment required
- **Certifications**: All technicians licensed and certified
- **Warranty**: 2-year warranty on completed work (3-year on bathroom waterproofing)
- **Languages**: Estonian, English, Russian
- **Service area**: Tallinn (all 8 districts) + Harjumaa (Maardu, Keila, Saue, Viimsi, Rae, Saku, and surrounding municipalities)
- **Legal entity**: Torudeabi24.ee OÜ, Vene tn 28, Tallinn 10111, Estonia

## Pricing (VAT excluded)

- Standard hourly rate: €35/hour (plumbing, electrical, carpentry, general works)
- Specialist rate: €45–48/hour (welding, pipe inspection, heat exchanger cleaning)
- Pressure testing (heating systems): €100–110 per session
- Sewerage high-pressure jetting: €100 per session
- Discount: -30% on all services weekdays and weekends 08:00–19:00
- Night surcharge: +€10 per job between 19:00–08:00
- Travel: €1.00–1.50/km outside Tallinn city limits
- Minimum charge: 1 hour at applicable hourly rate
- Payment: after completion only — no upfront payment required
- Full price list: https://torudeabi24.ee/en/price-list

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How fast do you respond to plumbing emergencies in Tallinn?**
A: Our emergency team arrives within 30–60 minutes anywhere in Tallinn and Harjumaa. Call +372 56 89 79 29 any time, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week including public holidays.

**Q: Are your technicians licensed and certified in Estonia?**
A: Yes. All TorudeAbi24 technicians hold current Estonian trade certifications. Plumbers are certified per Ehitusseadustik regulations. Electricians hold Elektriohutusseadus licences. Gas engineers hold Gaasiseadus certification required by Majandus- ja Kommunikatsiooniministeerium.

**Q: Do you offer a warranty on completed work?**
A: Yes. All completed work carries a 2-year warranty for normal daily use conditions, per Estonian Võlaõigusseadus § 218. Bathroom renovations carry a separate 3-year warranty on waterproofing and tiling.

**Q: Which areas of Tallinn and Harjumaa do you serve?**
A: We cover all Tallinn districts (Kesklinn, Mustamäe, Kristiine, Lasnamäe, Põhja-Tallinn, Nõmme, Pirita, Haabersti) and Harjumaa including Maardu, Keila, Saue, Saku, Viimsi, Rae vald, and surrounding municipalities.

**Q: What is the -30% discount and when does it apply?**
A: We offer a flat 30% discount on all services during standard hours: Monday–Sunday 08:00–19:00. Night work (19:00–08:00) is billed at full rate plus a €10 call-out surcharge.

**Q: Do you handle insurance claim repairs?**
A: Yes. We work directly with insurance assessors for water damage, fire damage, and mechanical damage reinstatement. We provide documented damage reports and itemised cost estimates for insurance companies (kindlustusjuhtum remont).

**Q: Can you do full apartment renovations?**
A: Yes. We offer turnkey apartment and office renovation including demolition, structural work, plumbing, electrical, tiling, plastering, painting, and finishing. Project management included.

**Q: What languages do your technicians speak?**
A: Estonian, English, and Russian. All technicians communicate fluently in at least Estonian and Russian.

**Q: Do you charge for the initial diagnosis?**
A: The diagnosis is free when you proceed with the repair. If you decline the work after diagnosis, a €35 diagnostic fee applies.

## Certifications & Regulatory Compliance

- Registered in Estonian Business Register: Torudeabi24.ee OÜ (Tallinn)
- Electricians licensed under Elektriohutusseadus (Electrical Safety Act)
- Gas engineers certified under Gaasiseadus (Gas Act), supervised by Majandus- ja Kommunikatsiooniministeerium
- Plumbers certified per Ehitusseadustik (Building Code of Estonia)
- All work documented with completion certificates on request
- Covered by professional liability insurance

## Service Area — Tallinn Districts

- **Kesklinn** (Old Town / city centre): highest demand for emergency plumbing and electrical
- **Lasnamäe**: largest district, Soviet-era panel buildings — pipe and heating replacement specialists
- **Mustamäe**: apartment block plumbing, heating, and electrical upgrades
- **Kristiine**: residential and commercial plumbing, bathroom renovation
- **Põhja-Tallinn** (Kalamaja, Pelgulinn, Kopli): old building renovation and pipe replacement
- **Nõmme**: detached houses, garden connections, well and septic services
- **Pirita**: coastal residential area, premium renovation services
- **Haabersti** (Õismäe, Rocca al Mare): modern apartment services

## Service Area — Harjumaa Towns

- **Maardu**: industrial and residential eastern Harjumaa
- **Keila**: southwestern Harjumaa town and surrounding vald
- **Saue**: Saue vald residential services
- **Saku vald**: southern suburb corridor
- **Viimsi**: northern peninsula premium residential
- **Rae vald** (Ülemiste City area): mixed commercial and residential
- **Jõelähtme vald**, **Kose vald**: rural and semi-rural coverage on request

## Emergency Response Protocol

Available 24/7 for immediate dispatch:
- Burst pipes and active water leaks → average 35-minute arrival in Tallinn
- Blocked drains and sewerage flooding → same-day clearance guaranteed
- Complete electrical failures and outages → licensed electrician dispatched
- Gas leaks → evacuate premises first, then call +372 56 89 79 29; gas-certified engineer dispatched
- Boiler and heating system breakdowns → priority in winter months (November–March)
- Flooding from neighbours above → emergency water shutdown and damage assessment

Response time commitment: 30–60 minutes in Tallinn, up to 90 minutes in Harjumaa.
